bibl.title: Palm Sunday
Hymn 52 on the Reception of Our Saviour Jesus Christ

noteGrp.note: A Syriac liturgical hymn for Palm Sunday centered on the children’s "Hosannas" at Christ’s entry into Jerusalem. It belongs to the Palm Sunday sequence numbered 51–57 in Brooks’s edition of the Syriac Hymns of Severus of Antioch and Others in Patrologia Orientalis VI.1. Listed under the subheading "Again Hymns on the Reception of our Savior Jesus Christ." Brooks numbers this as 52.

note.quote: ܡܪܝܐܐܠܗܐ ܕܦܘܪܩܢܝ ܒܡܢܐ ܢܬܕܡܪ ܡܢ ܗܠܝܢ ܕܒܡܥܠܬܟ ܗܘ̈ܝ
Lord God of my salvation - What shall we admire of the things that happened at thy entrance.
ܘܐܡ̇ܪ ܐܢܐ ܕܡ݁ܒܪܟܐ ܐܝܬܝܟ ܗ̇ܘ ܕܐܬܐ݂ ܘܥܬܝܕ ܬܘܒ ܕܢܐܬܐ
and I say, Blessed art thou that hast come and shalt come again.
